rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a verbal portrayal or the act of presenting something in words; use 畫 for a physical image.

example.english: The depiction of that old man in the passage is very vivid.
example.traditional: 呢段文字對嗰位老人嘅描述好傳神。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 man4 zi6 deoi3 go2 wai6 lou5 jan4 ge3 miu4 seot6 hou2 cyun4 san4

rows.note: Use this for a visual depiction and for a drawing or painting, especially when referring to the physical artwork.

example.english: This depiction of Victoria Harbour at night is beautiful.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫將維港嘅夜景畫得好靚。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 zoeng1 wai4 gong2 ge3 je6 ging2 waa2 dak1 hou2 leng3
